name: Track & Trace
one_liner: GS1 serialization, case and pallet aggregation, and pack-level movement events across the supply chain.
fits_when: packaging lines print a unique GS1 serial on every saleable pack
units are aggregated into cases and pallets with SSCC labels
every ship and receive between plant, warehouse and distributor must be recorded at pack level
distributors or pharmacies need to verify a pack is genuine and not recalled
QA must recall a batch and know exactly which location holds every unit
a regulator or trading partner expects EPCIS-style event history
gives_you: Batches with QA release, quarantine and expiry, and a batch 360 page with serials, cases, pallets and events
Serial numbers with their status, case, current location and a suspect flag
Case and pallet aggregation with seal, ship, receive and unpack steps
An append-only movement event log with automatic validation and an exception queue
Recall by batch: every holding location notified, returns confirmed and recovery tracked
Distributor logins that see only stock and receipts at their own location

catalogue.description: Pack-level track and trace for pharma: packaging lines commission GS1 serial numbers, units are aggregated into cases and pallets, every movement between plants, warehouses and distributors is logged as a validated event, and QA can quarantine or recall a batch and trace every unit to the location holding it. Distributors sign in and see only their own stock, receipts and recall notices.
